error_category_mapping.diagnostic_sentence: If the answer is assumed to be 0, the issue is substituting zero without evaluating the remaining constants. This directly affects y-intercepts of quadratic graphs.

hint_ladder.title: Substitute zero
hint_ladder.prompt: Substituting x = 0 means replace every x with 0 before calculating the brackets.

hint_ladder.title: Evaluate brackets
hint_ladder.prompt: Work out (0 - 3) and (0 + 2), then multiply the two bracket values.

hint_ladder.title: Zero is active
hint_ladder.prompt: A common slip is ignoring x = 0 or assuming the whole answer is 0. The constants in the brackets still matter.

hint_ladder.title: Substitution routine
hint_ladder.prompt: Replace x first, simplify each bracket second, then multiply. Apply those steps here; do not copy.
